sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The Settings page consists of five tabs: General, Titles, Institutions, Google Workspace Settings and About. From these tabs you manage the app's branding, the Google Workspace connection settings, and the reference data used in the New User / signature flow.

sections.heading: General Tab
paragraphs: Company name, sidebar abbreviation, logo, email notification sender name, allowed sign-in domain and the app language are set here. The Security card (master password and auto-lock) also lives on this tab; see the Master Password & Security section below for details.

callout.text: When branding info is changed, the sidebar and header update instantly; the same app is adapted to different organizations from this tab.

sections.heading: Master Password & Security
paragraphs: GoWorks keeps your sensitive keys (the Service Account key and the Google session) encrypted in a master-password vault. These keys are stored only on this device and the vault is unlocked with the master password you set during initial setup.

Auto-lock: If there's no activity for the configured period, the vault locks and asks for the master password to continue. You pick the timeout on the Security card: 15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, or Off.

Locking is not logging out: While locked your Google session is preserved — enter the password and you continue right where you left off, losing nothing. Logging out, by contrast, deletes the session token and requires a fresh Google sign-in. If a bulk job is running when you lock, it keeps going until it finishes (graceful lock).

Change the master password: Use the button on the Security card to change your password in place. Your encrypted keys are preserved — no need to re-upload the Service Account or sign in to Google again.

callout.text: If you forget your master password it cannot be recovered. The only path forward is resetting the vault, which deletes the stored Service Account key and Google session. You then have to re-upload the Service Account and sign in to Google again.

sections.heading: Setup Wizard & Reset
paragraphs: Two reset options sit at the bottom of the General tab. Restart the setup wizard reopens the onboarding steps while keeping your existing configuration (OAuth, Service Account, branding). Reset GoWorks performs a factory reset that permanently deletes all data, including company details, OAuth credentials, the Service Account, signature templates, job history and your session.

callout.text: Reset GoWorks cannot be undone. To prevent accidental triggering you are asked to type RESET into the box to confirm; the app then returns to a fresh setup.

sections.heading: Titles Tab
paragraphs: Manage the list of titles that can be assigned to users (Manager, Teacher, etc.) here, and add several at once with the Bulk add button. Defined titles are selected on the New User page and used in the signature template as the {{unvan}} variable.

sections.heading: Institutions Tab
paragraphs: Each institution's name, address and phone are defined here. Defined institutions are selected on the New User page and appear in the signature template as the {{kurum_adi}}, {{kurum_adres}} and {{kurum_telefon}} variables. You can add several at once with the Bulk add button.

callout.text: The Institutions feature is meant for organizations with multiple branches or locations. Each branch/location is defined as a separate institution, so every user's signature carries their own branch details. Single-location companies can define just one institution.

sections.heading: Google Workspace Settings Tab
paragraphs: Google Cloud OAuth credentials, required APIs, and the Service Account and Domain-Wide Delegation configuration live on this tab. The Service Account and DWD are required for signature management.

sections.heading: About Tab
paragraphs: The application version, license (Apache 2.0), trademark notices, and the open-source libraries used are listed here. The Terms of Use and liability-disclaimer summary, along with the relevant Google links, are also shown on this tab.
